title: Evaluation of Dermatomal Distribution in the Erector Spinae Plane (ESP) Block
brief_summary: Interventional study that evaluate dermatomal distribution and its demographic determinants in patients who underwent to Erector Spinae Plane (ESP) block
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients older than 18 years, in the acute / chronic pain service that presents pain in the thoracic region and / or upper hemiabdomen.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women in pregnancy
* Patients with less than 50 Kg of weight
* Dissent of informed consent
